ITEM 1 | Dark green spinach leaves, flat and glossy with slightly wrinkled surfaces, covering most of the bowl's base and edges, about 1 mm thick, individual leaves roughly 6-8 cm long, sitting under other ingredients | 60
ITEM 2 | Pale yellow-cream shaved hard cheese in thin irregular flakes and shards, 2-5 cm across, dry and slightly crumbly edges with a matte surface, scattered over the upper and right half of the salad and sitting on top of the greens and carrot | 45
ITEM 3 | Orange thin julienned carrot strands, bright orange with slightly glossy surface, about 4-6 cm long and 2-3 mm thick, clustered in the center and lower left of the bowl, tangled loosely | 25
ITEM 4 | Dark purple-black whole olives, smooth glossy skins with slight wrinkles, roughly 1.5-2 cm diameter, some halved or whole, scattered across the center and lower left among the carrot and spinach | 30
